infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hawkeye uses the camera to photograph the official result sheet and the polling unit itself — the evidence behind every report.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hawkeye uses the microphone only when you record a video of an incident, so the recording has sound.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Hawkeye records a GPS fix when you capture evidence or map a polling unit, to prove reports come from where they claim.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hawkeye lets you attach existing photos or videos from your library to an incident report.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Hawkeye does not use Face ID. This entry exists only because the secure-storage library references Apple's biometric API; your session is stored without any biometric prompt.

plugins.cameraPermission: Hawkeye uses the camera to photograph the official result sheet and the polling unit itself — the evidence behind every report.
plugins.microphonePermission: Hawkeye uses the microphone only when you record a video of an incident, so the recording has sound.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Hawkeye records a GPS fix when you capture evidence or map a polling unit, to prove reports come from where they claim.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Hawkeye only reads your location while you are using the app, to prove a report came from the polling unit it names. It never requests background or always-on location and does not track you when the app is closed.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Hawkeye only reads your location while you are using the app, to prove a report came from the polling unit it names. It never requests background or always-on location and does not track you when the app is closed.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Hawkeye does not use motion or fitness data. This entry exists only because the bundled location library references Apple's motion API; Hawkeye never requests or reads it.
